run_structure_generator: run the StructureGenerator to create adsorbate slab placements and write vasp input files to disk
precompute_slabs: precompute slab surfaces for a bulk material index and save vasp inputs to the precomputed directory
run_placements: run adsorbate placement generation for a given adsorbate bulk and surface index tuple using multiprocessing
write_surface: write vasp input files and metadata pickle for a single slab surface to the output directory
parse_args: parse command line arguments for bulk adsorbate surface indices placement modes and multiprocessing chunk options
